subject.title: feat: add metadata-only message audit events

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this bounded, opt-in message-lifecycle audit contract as a permanent core operator surface?
rationale: The PR is protected by the maintainer label and introduces new feature, configuration, gateway-protocol, persisted-state, and privacy contracts without an explicit product-approval comment.

options.title: Approve bounded core audit
options.body: Accept the proposed contract after redacted real upgrade and privacy proof confirms the documented behavior.

options.title: Narrow permanent contracts
options.body: Reduce the configuration, protocol, correlation identity, or lifecycle coverage surface before acceptance.

options.title: Decline core expansion
options.body: Keep message lifecycle visibility in diagnostics and exporters rather than the durable audit ledger.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded core audit
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed contract after redacted real upgrade and privacy proof confirms the documented behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the existing audit contract and authored both the linked request and this implementation.
